996	  router.get("/issues/:id/heartbeat-context", async (req, res) => {

1004	
1005	    const wakeCommentId =

1008	        : null;
1009	
1010	    const currentExecutionWorkspacePromise = issue.executionWorkspaceId
1011	      ? executionWorkspacesSvc.getById(issue.executionWorkspaceId)
1012	      : Promise.resolve(null);

1014	      { project, goal },
1015	      ancestors,
1016	      commentCursor,
1017	      wakeComment,
1018	      relations,
1019	      blockerAttention,
1020	      productivityReview,
1021	      attachments,
1022	      continuationSummary,
1023	      currentExecutionWorkspace,
1024	    ] =
1025	      await Promise.all([
1026	        resolveIssueProjectAndGoal(issue),
1027	        svc.getAncestors(issue.id),
1028	        svc.getCommentCursor(issue.id),
1029	        wakeCommentId ? svc.getComment(wakeCommentId) : null,
1030	        svc.getRelationSummaries(issue.id),
1031	        svc.listBlockerAttention(issue.companyId, [issue]).then((map) => map.get(issue.id) ?? null),
1032	        svc.listProductivityReviews(issue.companyId, [issue.id]).then((map) => map.get(issue.id) ?? null),
1033	        svc.listAttachments(issue.id),
1034	        documentsSvc.getIssueDocumentByKey(issue.id, ISSUE_CONTINUATION_SUMMARY_DOCUMENT_KEY),
1035	        currentExecutionWorkspacePromise,
1036	      ]);
1037	
1038	    res.json({
1039	      issue: {
1040	        id: issue.id,
1041	        identifier: issue.identifier,
1042	        title: issue.title,
1043	        description: issue.description,
1044	        status: issue.status,
1045	        ...(blockerAttention ? { blockerAttention } : {}),
1046	        productivityReview,
1047	        priority: issue.priority,
1048	        projectId: issue.projectId,
1049	        goalId: goal?.id ?? issue.goalId,
1050	        parentId: issue.parentId,
1051	        blockedBy: relations.blockedBy,

1053	        assigneeAgentId: issue.assigneeAgentId,
1054	        assigneeUserId: issue.assigneeUserId,
1055	        originKind: issue.originKind,
1056	        originId: issue.originId,
1057	        updatedAt: issue.updatedAt,
1058	      },
1059	      ancestors: ancestors.map((ancestor) => ({
1060	        id: ancestor.id,
1061	        identifier: ancestor.identifier,
1062	        title: ancestor.title,
1063	        status: ancestor.status,
1064	        priority: ancestor.priority,
1065	      })),
1066	      project: project
1067	        ? {
1068	            id: project.id,
1069	            name: project.name,
1070	            status: project.status,
1071	            targetDate: project.targetDate,
1072	          }
1073	        : null,
1074	      goal: goal
1075	        ? {
1076	            id: goal.id,
1077	            title: goal.title,
1078	            status: goal.status,
1079	            level: goal.level,
1080	            parentId: goal.parentId,
1081	          }
1082	        : null,
1083	      commentCursor,
1084	      wakeComment:
1085	        wakeComment && wakeComment.issueId === issue.id
1086	          ? wakeComment
1087	          : null,
1088	      attachments: attachments.map((a) => ({
1089	        id: a.id,

1092	        byteSize: a.byteSize,

1094	        createdAt: a.createdAt,
1095	      })),
1096	      continuationSummary: continuationSummary
1097	        ? {
1098	            key: continuationSummary.key,
1099	            title: continuationSummary.title,
1100	            body: continuationSummary.body,
1101	            latestRevisionId: continuationSummary.latestRevisionId,
1102	            latestRevisionNumber: continuationSummary.latestRevisionNumber,
1103	            updatedAt: continuationSummary.updatedAt,
1104	          }
1105	        : null,

1107	    });
1108	  });
